If v3 fails this protocol the result is recorded and the protocol is not iterated

common.contact_work: kick_average_v1: W_n, W_t = sum J . (g_n + g_{n+1}) / 2 with g_n = old after the P2G grid update and g_{n+1} = old after the final MUSL grid update; obstacle power P = sum J . v_obs; D_contact = (P_n - W_n) + (P_t - W_t)
common.books_layer_N: B(t) = E_kin + Psi_eq + E_grav + W_b - W_ext - (W_n + W_t), all from the reset state (E_kin particle KE, Psi_eq the equilibrium free energy = the frozen elastic energy for elastic materials, W_b the kick-paired Prony branch work with visco_energy = branch_work_kick_average_v2, W_ext the traction and Dirichlet work with traction_work = grid_displacement_v1 and constraint_work = kick_average_v1)
common.step_rule: dt = control_dt / ceil(control_dt / (cfl dx / c_p)), c_p with mu0 (instantaneous modulus)
common.loading: gravity and tractions ramped with 1/2 (1 - cos(pi t / T_ramp)) and updated every SUBSTEP on the CPU (quasi-static: a step load on an undamped elastic body overshoots by 2 and unloads its contacts periodically)
common.artificial_damping: none in the material; the contact law's declared dashpots act only on contact nodes and their dissipation is booked as contact dissipation (never as material or viscoelastic damping)
common.device: CPU (Warp) for RUBBER-CONT-01..07 and -10; GPU0 for -09 / -11
common.law_definition: grid_node_penalty_coulomb_v2 (common.law_definition of rubber_contact_tests_v2, unchanged: normal penalty k_n = kappa_n m_I / dt^2 with the dashpot on the realised velocity, Coulomb spring-dashpot-slider on the deepest obstacle with cap mu F_n) plus the PATCH SLIP-RATE EQUALISATION: a contact patch is one plane or one face of one box, per env (row e Q + q, Q = P + 6 F B; the face of a node in a box is the face of the box-frame outward normal of the SDF); in pass 1 every node's v2 trial is evaluated and the nodes whose trial SLIPS on a patch with mu > 0 add m_I v_t and m_I to their patch row (v_t = realised tangential velocity relative to the obstacle point); in pass 2 each such node gets, in addition to the capped Coulomb force and outside the slider (the anchor follows the capped Coulomb force only), the impulse -dt c_d (v_t - vbar), c_d = 2 zeta_d sqrt(k_t m_I), vbar = sum m v_t / sum m of its patch in the same substep. c_d is proportional to m_I, so the equalisation impulses of a patch sum to zero and the patch's total tangential force stays <= mu sum F_n; with mu = 0 the law is v2. The equalisation is booked as contact damping (work column 5); kick-paired work unchanged
common.law_parameter_status: kappa_n, kappa_t, zeta_n, zeta_t unchanged from v1 / v2; zeta_d = 1 (2 zeta_d sqrt(kappa_t) = 1: the whole slip-rate deviation of a slipping node removed per substep, the largest value the explicit update admits), chosen in the X2 DIAGNOSTIC (dev mode 13) before this declaration, not tuned on any row of this protocol
common.solver: single env: LiveRubberMaterial(contact=ContactSpec(law='grid_node_penalty_coulomb_v3', slip_rate_damping_ratio=1.0, ...)) -> TLMPMRubberContact (kernels rubber_contact.node_penalty_contact_v3_normal / _tangential, law commit b668bdc); batched: BatchedRubberMaterial (rubber_contact_batch.BatchedTLMPMRubberContact binds the same launch; patch rows e*Q + q)

INC.what: block 16 x 8 x 4 mm (strip-local), case free, corner at the origin; table plane z = 0 (normal +z); gravity 9.81 (sin theta, 0, -cos theta) ramped every substep with 1/2 (1 - cos(pi t / T_ramp)); friction_table = mu

INC2.what: block 24 x 12 x 6 mm, otherwise as INC

PEN.what: block 8 x 6 x 4 mm, case free, on a FRICTIONLESS table z = 0 (uniform base pressure), Prony P2 material, gravity -z, top traction pressure p (traction group: the top particle layer) ramped over 20 ms; mean node displacements over [0.04, 0.06] s

IMP.what: rod 40 x 4 x 4 mm along x, case free, no gravity, uniform initial velocity -0.3 m/s along x onto the FRICTIONLESS wall x = 0 (normal +x; the rod's end face starts on the wall)
IMP.reference: 1-D elastic rod on a rigid frictionless wall: contact duration 2 L / c0, c0 = sqrt(E_eff / rho), E_eff = 9 kappa mu0 / (3 kappa + mu0); rebound velocity = impact velocity (energy-conserving)

PINCH.what: case A strip, free length L 30 mm, W 10 mm, t 4 mm, n_t 3 and n_t 4 (same geometry, pads, squeeze depths and pull), jaw 2 dx clamped (group 0, F8 projection, kick-average work, held fixed); two pad frames of kind pad (friction_pad = mu_pad): top box x in [L - 8, L + 2] mm, y in [-2, W + 2] mm, z in [t, t + 2] mm, bottom box mirrored below z = 0; elastic material; no gravity
PINCH.design_estimate: uniaxial squeeze pressure E_eff 2 delta / t gives mu_pad (N_top + N_bottom) ~ 0.95 / 1.9 / 2.85 N, reached after ~0.5 / 1.1 / 1.6 mm of the 5 mm pull (axial stiffness ~1.8 kN/m)
PINCH.slip_detection: tip-marker velocity along x below 0.5 x pull speed while the pads move: slip; the sustained-slip window is the last 10 ms of the pull

RUBBER-CONT-01.name: incline: stick below and Coulomb slip above tan theta = mu, slip onset at tan theta = mu
RUBBER-CONT-01.scene: INC and INC2, each at n_t 3 and n_t 4 (groups (scene, n_t))
RUBBER-CONT-01.reference: rigid-body Coulomb: stick (a = 0) for tan theta < mu; a = g (sin theta - mu cos theta) for tan theta > mu; with a/(g cos theta) = tan theta - mu the onset is the zero of the linear slip branch

criteria.a_stick: every stick run (mu 0.2 / 0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 at ratios 0.6 / 0.85 / 0.95, elastic; the P2 rows at 0.95 for mu 0.6 / 0.8), every group: |x_cm(end) - x_cm(0.02 s)| <= stick_disp_rel * s and |a_fit| <= stick_acc_rel * g cos theta
criteria.b_slip: every slip run (mu 0.2-0.8, ratios 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3), every group: |a_fit - g (sin theta - mu cos theta)| <= slip_acc_rel * g cos theta
criteria.c_onset: per group and mu: linear fit of a/(g cos theta) against tan theta over the three slip runs; |mu_eff / mu - 1| <= onset_rel
criteria.d_books: every scored run: max_t |B(t)| <= books_rel * S, S = max_t (E_kin + Psi) + max_t |E_grav(t)| (unchanged from v1 / v2; the stick-run residual judged in ADR 0023 section 22.10 is not redefined); books_order_row (INC, n_t 3): max |B| at cfl 0.25 <= ratio_max * max |B| at cfl 0.5, or both <= floor_rel * S
criteria.e_validity: no invalid flag in any run (scored or reported)
criteria.f_ramp_slip: NEW (load-ramp slip, X2 finding): every stick run: |x_cm(T_ramp) - x_cm(0)| <= ramp_disp_rel * s (the centroid displacement during the 20 ms proportional load ramp; elastic shear alone is ~3e-4 s)

RUBBER-CONT-01.expectation_declared_before_the_run: X2 DIAGNOSTIC (dev mode 13, seen): INC n_t 3 / 4 and INC2 n_t 3 at mu 0.6 / 0.8 slide within 0.01 % and hold; INC2 n_t 4 at mu 0.8, every mu 0.2 / 0.4 row and the P2 rows under v3 are unseen: a / b / c / e / f PASS expected; d FAILs expected on stick runs (the static-jitter residual of section 22.10, 1-2 % of S) and are reported, never re-scored; mu 1.0 rows: n_t 3 diagnostic passed, n_t 4 failed (+2.4 %): reported with labels only

RUBBER-CONT-02.name: penetration vs grid / dt refinement
RUBBER-CONT-02.reference: the v2 law: the dashpot sees the realised velocity, 0 at a static fixed point, so delta_I = F_I / k_n for the damped and the undamped law alike (proportional to dt^2 / dx at fixed pressure and CFL)

criteria.a_bound: every resolution: max node penetration over the window <= pen_max_rel * s
criteria.b_dt: mean interior-face-node penetration: delta(n_t 2, cfl 0.25) / delta(n_t 2, cfl 0.5) in dt_ratio_band (law: 0.25)
criteria.c_dx: delta(n_t 4, cfl 0.5) / delta(n_t 2, cfl 0.5) in dx_ratio_band (law: 0.5)
criteria.d_law: undamped variant: sum over face nodes of k_n delta_I = table reaction within law_rel, and the mean interior-face delta_I / (p A_I / k_n) within law_rel_node
criteria.e_balance: every run: mean table reaction over the window = weight + p A within balance_rel
criteria.f_law_v2: every DAMPED run: sum over face nodes of k_n delta_I = table reaction within law_rel (v1: 0.5 by design; tighter, new in v2)

RUBBER-CONT-03.name: normal impact and rebound: energy accounting with contact work, elastic energy and viscoelastic dissipation separated

criteria.a_books: every run: max_t |B(t)| <= books_rel * E0 (E0 = 1/2 M V^2) and |B(end)| <= books_end_rel * E0; elastic and P2 at n_t 4: max |B| at cfl 0.25 <= ratio_max * max |B| at cfl 0.5 (first order) or both <= floor_rel * E0
criteria.b_contact_time: elastic, n_t 4, cfl 0.5: first to last substep-sampled contact (any normal impulse in a control step) t_c satisfies |t_c / (2 L / c0) - 1| <= tc_rel
criteria.c_attribution: every run, after separation: the energy missing from E_kin + Psi_eq is exactly the booked dissipation: D_contact = -(W_n + W_t) >= 0 (static wall) and, with Prony terms, D_b = W_b - Psi_v >= 0 (branch work minus the stored branch energy); D_contact / E0 <= contact_loss_max at n_t 4 (reported with its normal / tangential split; the wall is frictionless, so the tangential part is ~0)
criteria.d_convergence: elastic, cfl 0.5: D_contact(n_t 4) <= conv_ratio_max * D_contact(n_t 2) (the declared dashpots act on the contact node layer, whose mass fraction is O(dx))
criteria.e_penetration: every run: max node penetration <= pen_max_rel * s
criteria.f_reported: rebound centroid velocity / V, the elastic vs P2 rebound, D_b / E0, the undamped-law rebound (probe) for comparison

RUBBER-CONT-04.scene: INC and INC2 at n_t 3 and n_t 4 (every scored slip run)
RUBBER-CONT-04.reference: rigid Coulomb sliding: dissipation = mu integral N dx_cm

criteria.a_total: every slip run: |D_contact / (mu sum_k N_k dx_cm,k) - 1| <= dissipation_rel, N_k the table normal force of control step k (wrench), dx_cm,k the centroid increment along the slope; D_contact = -(W_n + W_t) over the whole run
criteria.b_split: reported: Coulomb-slider, tangential-dashpot and normal-dashpot shares (sliding excites normal contact vibration that the normal dashpot dissipates; the tangential share alone is not the rigid-body value)

RUBBER-CONT-09.calibration: scripts/rubber/p2_4/cont09_band_calibration.py (seed 20261111, 2e6 samples): under H0 (A and B exchangeable run-to-run noise) the per-scalar false-reject probability of the rule is <= 5.5e-6 for Gaussian, Laplace, Student-t(3) and uniform noise (eps_rel = 0, worst case); family-wise <= n_scalars * 5.5e-6 by the union bound (valid under any dependence), <= 0.4 % for the <= 648 scalars of the v1 configuration. A coupling is rejected for sure when its A-to-B shift exceeds (lam + 1) s
RUBBER-CONT-09.v1_rule_assessment: UNSOUND as declared: the v1 band max|A - A'| + 1e-6 max|A| uses ONE repeat; under H0 P(|A - B| > |A - A'|) = 1/2 by exchangeability (simulated 0.500), so every scalar whose run-to-run noise exceeds the 1e-6 floor is a coin flip and ~10^2 scalars reject almost surely. The v1 FAIL of gpu_cont09_001 (1 of 108 rows, a clamp wrench 1.23e-7 N vs 9.2e-8 N) stays preserved; it is not evidence of coupling
